# Per-target summary (generated by analyze.py)

Window log10 sigma <= -1.5. Exponent = per-seed slope of -log10(plateau duration) on log10(sigma): median [quartiles] (n fitted seeds). Predictions: paper = max(c*_J - 2, 0) (0 also when nothing is missing), route = k* - 2 of the numerical route rule at the plateau point, pair = pairwise rule, hand = registered by-hand order - 2; in brackets the fraction of seeds within 0.3 and the decision. canon = fraction of plateau points within 0.03 of a partial target. Escape: strict / degenerate with x = slope of log|lambda_min| on log sigma. eff = median effective depth of the escape (loss estimator).
